propositions: Four read-only git-derivable metrics must be implemented: module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, churn, and refactor_to_addition_ratio, each computing deterministically from git history and working tree against a single-sourced module-size hard cap.
module_size_distribution scans src/rebar/**/*.py line counts at a ref against the cap from .github/module-size-limit.txt, returning count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, and max_loc.
cap_change_events surfaces commit-level changes to .github/module-size-limit.txt over a date range, returning a list of dicts with old_limit and new_limit (empty list when no changes occur).
churn computes insertions and deletions summed from git log --numstat over a range, and refactor_to_addition_ratio returns deletions/insertions or None when insertions total is zero.
Each of the four metrics must be registered in REGISTRY with lens='code_health', source='git', confidence='high', and a compute adapter pulling repo_root, since, and until from the context.

Unit tests must validate exact return values for module_size_distribution, churn, refactor_to_addition_ratio, and cap_change_events against fixture git repos and confirm all four metrics are present in REGISTRY with correct labels.
